title: Size of a mapped list of circuits
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$, and let $f$ map each element of $\alpha$ to a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables. The sum of the sizes of the circuits $f(a)$ as $a$ ranges over $l$, counted with repetitions, equals the sum of the sizes of the mapped list of circuits.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of elements of $\alpha$
$f$ maps elements of $\alpha$ to circuits on $n$ variables
